scenarios.name: blobs/rust-get-sendme
scenarios.description: The Rust driver's iroh-blobs 0.103.0 client asks a Go provider for a hash sequence of empty, 1-chunk, 16-chunk, 17-chunk, and 100000-byte blobs with sendme receive's first request, the whole sequence and the last chunk of every child, and a pass proves that go-iroh answers it with every blob iroh-blobs expects and that each verifies.

scenarios.name: blobs/rust-get-per-child
scenarios.description: The Rust driver's iroh-blobs 0.103.0 client asks a Go provider for the second and fourth children of the same hash sequence in full, and nothing else, as a resumed download does, and a pass proves that go-iroh answers a per-child request with exactly those blobs.
